subject: general
question: The Sepoy Revolt of 1857 started on which date?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sepoy Revolt of 1857, also known as the First War of Indian Independence, started on May 10, 1857.
 
• The introduction of the Enfield rifle with cartridges rumored to be greased with cow and pig fat offended both Hindu and Muslim sepoys.
 
• The Governor-General of India in 1857 was Lord Canning. 
 
• The first notable person to die in the Sepoy Revolt of 1857 was Mangal Pandey.
